difficulty_reason: Prove the Hilb schemes are smooth of relative dimension d over S: base cases Hilb^0 = S and Hilb^1 = X; induction step: Hilb^d x_S X is smooth over S (base change and composition of smooth morphisms) and maps finite locally free of degree d+1 onto Hilb^{d+1} (lemma-universal-object), so smoothness descends (descent-lemma-smooth-permanence); the relative dimension check (fibres or dimension bookkeeping) is left to the reader.
